chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim and Abu Basir and Buraid and Fuzayl, from Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) both having said:
Indeed, Allah imposed zakat along with salat.

key_terms.الزَّكَاة: Zakat — the obligatory alms-tax, one of the five pillars of Islam
key_terms.الصَّلَاة: Salat — the ritual prayer, one of the five pillars of Islam
key_terms.فَرَضَ: Imposed as a religious obligation (fard); stronger than mustahabb (recommended)
key_terms.مَعَ: Along with / together with — indicating simultaneous divine institution

ai.seo_question: Did Allah obligate zakat together with prayer according to the Imams of Ahlulbayt?
ai.summary: Both Imam al-Baqir and Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon them) declared that Allah made zakat obligatory together with salat (ritual prayer), establishing the inseparable pairing of these two pillars of Islam. This hadith reflects a fundamental principle of Shia jurisprudence: zakat is not an optional charity but a divine obligation paired structurally with prayer, as repeatedly affirmed in the Quran (e.g., 'establish prayer and give zakat'). The original audience — the students of the Imams in 2nd-century AH Kufa and Medina — would understand this as a direct ruling from the Imams clarifying that zakat's obligation is as foundational as salat.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, and Abu Baseer, and Bureyd and Fuzayl, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> and Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> both having said:
‘Allahazwj Imposed the Zakāt along with the Salāt’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim and abu Basir, Burayd and Fudayl who have said the following: “Abu Ja‘far and abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, have said that
Allah has made zakat obligatory along with Salah (prayer).”
